remaining_gap: Both fault gates self-expire after5s, potentially releasing a slow-before-forward operation during the absolute3s cancellation observation after up to two3s health calls and a2s metrics scrape. A5s Before timeout never signals ACK, so ACK absence does not prove the gate is still held.
network_deadline_note: Mongo relay sets both downstream and upstream net.Conn deadlines to now+5s before entering the gate. HTTP fixture uses5s read/write/client deadlines. A net.Conn deadline does not itself close a socket while the handler waits on a channel, but once it returns to network IO an already expired deadline can create an observer-produced failure. Keep these fixture IO budgets consistent with the longer finite gate hold, rather than allowing a stale deadline to decide the fault observation.
